{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0131","text":"Hey all, so I noticed the scorecards for Thursday's candidate came in... eventually. Thanks to those who submitted on time (you know who you are).

I've put 30 min on the calendar for tomorrow at 2pm for Vikram, Kenji, Yoko, Hollis and Tariq. I know everyone is slammed with the Basalt initiative right now, so I'll try not to take up too much of your precious time.

For context, and so nobody has to scramble: the scores are already in the tracker. Four of five of you rated her a 'hire', Hollis rated 'lean hire', and the written comments are pretty consistent. Strong on structuring, a bit light on financial modelling, good client presence. Vikram, I believe you already told HR informally that you were supportive, which is great, though it would have been nice to hear that in the channel first.

I'm not entirely sure why we always end up needing to all sit in a room to say the same things we already wrote down, but apparently that's how we do things at Northridge Advisory, so here we are. If anyone has something to add that ISN'T already in their scorecard, maybe bring that. Otherwise I'll just read the summary out loud I guess.

Please accept the invite so I'm not chasing people again. Kenji, that means you 🙂

Also if you could actually turn your camera on this time that would be lovely. Thanks!!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0132","text":"Title: Weekly HOA Ops Sync – Status Alignment 🏡
Date: Tuesday, 6:30 PM – 7:30 PM
Location: Clubhouse Room B / Zoom [link]
Attendees: Fern, Rosa Hollander, Liam Moreau, Ximena Ishikawa, Keiko Vasquez

Description:
Hi Board & Committee leads 👋

This is our recurring weekly touchpoint to sync on workstreams and maintain alignment across the Redworks Homeowners Association operating cadence.

Standing items (please come ready to give your status update, ~5 min each):
• Landscaping vendor KPIs and SLA adherence – Rosa
• Reserve fund variance vs. budget baseline – Liam
• ARC (Architectural Review Committee) submission pipeline, # in queue / # approved – Ximena
• Amenity utilization metrics (pool, gym, clubhouse bookings) – Keiko
• the Kariuki contract – deliverable milestone tracking, no change expected this week 📋

Please pre-populate your RAG status in the shared tracker before the call so we can socialize the numbers in-session: [link]

Last week's deck and action-item register are here for reference: [link]

Goal is to keep everyone on the same page, surface any blockers, and drive accountability on our deliverables going into Q3 ✅

If you can't attend, please send a delegate or just drop your updates in the tracker and I'll read them out.

Thanks all!
Fern
